title: 10. Exercises: Async I/O Libraries
summary: Next: 14_mixing_concurrency.md — Learn to mix threads, processes, and asyncio →
objectives: Solve the Async I/O Libraries exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Parallel Web Scraper

Create async web scraper:

1. Fetch multiple URLs
2. Extract links
3. Follow links (depth limit)
4. Save results

### Exercise 2: Chat Server

Create WebSocket chat:

1. Multiple clients
2. Broadcast messages
3. Private messages
4. User list

### Exercise 3: Database CRUD API

Create async REST API:

1. Connect to PostgreSQL
2. CRUD operations
3. Connection pooling
4. Error handling

### Exercise 4: Rate-Limited Client

Create rate-limited HTTP client:

1. Max N requests/second
2. Retry on 429
3. Exponential backoff

### Exercise 5: File Sync Tool

Create file sync tool:

1. Watch directory
2. Upload changes
3. Download changes
4. Handle conflicts

### Exercise 6: Real-time Dashboard

Create dashboard:

1. WebSocket server
2. Push updates
3. Multiple data sources
4. Client reconnection

### Exercise 7: Cache Layer

Create Redis cache layer:

1. Get with cache
2. Invalidation
3. TTL support
4. Batch operations

### Exercise 8: Streaming Download

Create download manager:

1. Multiple downloads
2. Progress tracking
3. Resume support
4. Speed limiting

### Exercise 9: API Gateway

Create API gateway:

1. Route requests
2. Load balancing
3. Circuit breaker
4. Rate limiting

### Exercise 10: Event Sourcing

Create event system:

1. Publish events
2. Subscribe handlers
3. Event replay
4. Persistence
